incident-bot: AUTO-PAGER fired -> policy=GPU_MEMORY_HEARTBEAT; pool=infer-west2a; metric=mem.used_pct; threshold=95%; sample: node gpu-node-34 mem.used_pct=98.7% x3 nodes; error=NVML: out of memory; pd=P-99991; severity=P1; link=https://pd/incident/P-99991

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident P-99991 created and routed to oncall-dana -> https://pd/incident/P-99991 (escalation policy: eng-oncall)

Dana (oncall): ack — I'm taking this. seeing repeating OOM spikes on that pool. starting triage.

Anya (eng-sre): jumping in. quick ask: which customer routes to infer-west2a now? any high-traffic jobs?

Lucas (support): AtlasSearch (tenant: atlas-ops) reports elevated 500s since +7m. CS ticket #8842 opened, linking logs they sent.

Dana (oncall): confirmed - AtlasSearch traffic pinned to infer-west2a for some routes. impact estimate: ~6% error rate on their gen calls, latency +200ms median.

Dana (oncall): mitigation plan: cordon+drain the most noisy node then reroute traffic via fallback pool. also reduce prefetch and batch caps on the llama-13b-quant route. doing cordon/drain now.

Dana (oncall): ```bash
kubectl cordon gpu-node-34 --context=prod-west2
kubectl drain gpu-node-34 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30
```

incident-bot: Node eviction started; autoscaler provisioning warm replacement (pool=infer-west2a, +1 node); eviction progress: 1/6 pods evicted; ETA ~2-4m

Anya (eng-sre): looking at kvcache metrics: kvcache.evictions spiking before OOM. prefetch_ratio=0.8 and batch_size_max=16 on that route. suspect large prefetch + big batches causing KV blowup.

Dana (oncall): applying temporary route caps to reduce working set. patching traffic config now.

Dana (oncall): ```yaml
# patch for route: llama-13b-quant
- route: /v1/llama-13b-quant
  settings:
    batch_size_max: 4
    prefetch_ratio: 0.3
    kv_cache_ttl: 60s
```

pagerduty-bot: Acknowledged by dana. Next escalation in 10m to oncall-mike if not resolved.

Mike (next-oncall): oncall-mike here — ping me if it keeps flapping or if we need cross-region failover.

Dana (oncall): node drained successfully, pods rescheduled to fallback pool infer-east1. AtlasSearch error rate trending down: 6% -> 1.2% over 6m. latency back within SLO for small batches.

Lucas (support): notif sent to AtlasSearch: brief degradation noticed, mitigation applied, monitoring. CS will follow up once we stabilize.

Anya (eng-sre): leaving a note: follow-up action -> add kvcache eviction alerts, consider lowering default prefetch for llama routes, investigate why autoscaler warm pool delayed by ~90s.

Dana (oncall): Handoff: leaving incident open for 1h observation; will update postmortem tag and owner (eng-sre/anya). handing to mike if anything recurs. :white_check_mark:

Mike (next-oncall): taking watch. if error rate >2% for 5m I will escalate to infra-sre and open PD P-99992 for deeper root-cause.

incident-bot: Incident state: monitoring; pd=P-99991 status=acknowledged; tags=[gpu, mem-heartbeat, kvcache, atlassearch]; auto-escalation=1768888177
